description: Project-authored deterministic reasoning and knowledge suite for Laptop Model Bench v1.2. Contains 36 four-choice tasks across six equally sized domains, with balanced answer positions and difficulty.
system_prompt: You are taking a deterministic benchmark. Answer without tools or external access.

task_design.notes: All items are project-authored. Correct answer positions are balanced overall to reduce answer-position bias.

tasks.question: What is 18 × 7 - 26?
What is 35% of 240?
A $150 item is discounted by 20%, then the discounted price is reduced by another 10%. What is the final price?
Three groups are in the ratio 2:3:5 and contain 80 people total. How many people are in the second group?
Four identical machines make 360 parts in 6 hours. At the same constant rate, how many parts do six machines make in 5 hours?
A bag contains 4 red and 3 blue marbles. Two marbles are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
A train travels at 60 km/h for 1.5 hours, then at 90 km/h for 2 hours. What total distance does it travel?
A school has 120 students. Three fifths are girls. One quarter of the girls are absent. How many girls are present?
A 160-liter tank is 3/8 full. Then water equal to one quarter of the tank's total capacity is added. How much water is now in the tank?
A population of 800 increases by 25% and then decreases by 20%. What is the final population?
A father is three times as old as his son. In 12 years, the father will be twice as old as his son. How old is the father now?
Worker A can finish a job alone in 6 hours. Worker B can finish the same job alone in 12 hours. If they work together at constant rates, how long will the job take?
All ravens are birds. No birds are mammals. Which statement must be true?
Ana arrives before Ben. Ben arrives before Cara. Dan arrives after Cara. Who must arrive first?
S must occur before P. P must occur before Q. R occurs after Q. Which event must occur earliest?
All glens are nors. Some nors are feks. No feks are zims. Which statement must be true?
Alice and Bob are each either always truthful or always lying. Alice says, 'Bob is lying.' Bob says, 'Alice and I are the same type.' Which assignment is consistent?
If the build passes, deployment occurs. If deployment occurs, monitoring starts. Monitoring did not start. Which conclusion must follow?

choices.D: Nothing can be concluded about the build.

tasks.question: A 12-volt potential difference is applied across a 4-ohm resistor. What current flows according to Ohm's law?
In normal double-stranded DNA, adenine pairs with which base?
In the OSI model, which layer is primarily responsible for routing IP packets between networks?
If an object's speed doubles while its mass remains constant, what happens to its kinetic energy?

choices.B: It becomes four times as large.

tasks.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted random-access array of n elements?
Under the standard SQL isolation levels, what is the least restrictive isolation level that prevents dirty reads?
Which Git command normally shows the state of the working tree and staging area?
What does HTTP status code 404 normally indicate?

choices.B: The requested resource was not found
choices.C: The server completed the request successfully

tasks.question: A test checks one pure function in isolation with no external services or filesystem access. What type of test is this most directly?
A Python function uses def add_item(x, items=[]): and appends to items. Unexpected values persist between calls. What is the standard fix?

choices.B: Delete the list after every append.
choices.C: Convert items to a tuple before returning.
choices.D: Use None as the default and create a new list inside the function.

tasks.question: Two threads increment the same shared counter without synchronization. Why can increments be lost?

choices.A: The read-modify-write operations can interleave and overwrite one another.
choices.B: Integer addition always clears the CPU cache.
choices.C: Each thread automatically receives a permanent private copy of the variable.
choices.D: The operating system forbids two threads from reading the same memory.

tasks.question: Which HTTP method is defined to be idempotent when used according to HTTP semantics?
Sam puts ice cream in the freezer before leaving home for several hours. What is the most likely reason?

choices.C: To keep the ice cream frozen

tasks.question: The trophy did not fit in the suitcase because it was too small. In the most natural interpretation, what was too small?
Jordan called Alex after they left the office. Based only on this sentence, who left the office?
A meeting originally scheduled for Tuesday is moved to two days later. On what day is it now scheduled?
A server responds slowly to one request. No other evidence is available. Which conclusion is justified?

choices.C: One slow response was observed, but its cause is not established.

tasks.question: Report A says there are 12 units in stock. Report B says there are 15. No information is given about which report is newer or more reliable. What can be concluded?

choices.D: The reports disagree, so the actual quantity cannot be determined from the given information.
